rice.name: Rice
rice.desc: Rice is the staple food for more than half of the world's population. Requires abundant water and warm climate.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.desc: Wheat is one of the most important cereals. Grown in the Rabi season across northern India.

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.desc: Cotton is a major fiber crop requiring warm climate. India is the largest producer.

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane
sugarcane.desc: Sugarcane is a tropical grass requiring high temperature and abundant water.

maize.name: Maize
maize.desc: Maize is a versatile crop used for food, fodder, and industrial purposes.

groundnut.name: Groundnut
groundnut.desc: Groundnut is an important oilseed crop grown mainly in Gujarat and Rajasthan.

soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.desc: Soybean is a protein-rich crop used for oil extraction. Major producer: MP.

mustard.name: Mustard
mustard.desc: Mustard is an important Rabi oilseed crop grown across Rajasthan and UP.

potato.name: Potato
potato.desc: Potato is a major vegetable crop requiring cool climate. UP is top producer.

tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.desc: Tomato is a popular vegetable crop grown throughout India in all seasons.

onion.name: Onion
onion.desc: Onion is a major spice crop requiring cool climate. Maharashtra leads production.

chilli.name: Chilli
chilli.desc: Chilli is an important spice crop. Andhra Pradesh is the largest producer.

turmeric.name: Turmeric
turmeric.desc: Turmeric is a rhizomatous spice crop. India produces 80% of the world's supply.

banana.name: Banana
banana.desc: Banana is a tropical fruit requiring warm climate and abundant moisture.

mango.name: Mango
mango.desc: Mango is the national fruit of India. UP, AP, and Karnataka lead production.

tea.name: Tea
tea.desc: Tea is grown in hilly areas with heavy rainfall. Assam and Darjeeling are famous.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.desc: Coffee is grown in the hilly regions of Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu.

coconut.name: Coconut
coconut.desc: Coconut is a versatile palm crop grown along coastal areas of Kerala and Karnataka.

jute.name: Jute
jute.desc: Jute is the golden fiber of India. West Bengal is the largest producer.

chana.name: Pulses (Chana)
chana.desc: Chickpea (Chana) is the most important pulse crop in India. MP leads production.

schemes.title: सरकारी योजनाएं
schemes.subtitle: किसानों के लिए कृषि योजनाओं और सब्सिडी का पता लगाएं

pmKisan.name: PM-KISAN
pmKisan.desc: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to farmer families.
pmKisan.details: Under this scheme, eligible farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each. Funds are transferred directly to the bank account.
pmKisan.eligibility: All farmer families with cultivable land

kcc.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
kcc.desc: Provides affordable credit to farmers for agricultural activities.
kcc.details: KCC provides timely credit at subsidized 4% per annum interest rate for crop production, post-harvest expenses, and farm maintenance.

pmfby.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
pmfby.desc: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme to protect against crop failure.
pmfby.details: Farmers pay premium of 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial crops. Government pays remaining premium.

soilHealth.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
soilHealth.desc: Free soil health cards with crop-wise nutrient recommendations.
soilHealth.details: Every farmer gets a soil health card every 2 years with nutrient status and fertilizer recommendations for their specific farm.

eNam.name: e-NAM
eNam.desc: Pan-India electronic trading portal linking APMCs across the country.
eNam.details: e-NAM connects 1,000+ mandis across India for transparent price discovery and better returns for farmers.

pmKmd.name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana
pmKmd.desc: Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers above 60 years.
pmKmd.details: Farmers receive ₹3,000 monthly pension after age 60. Contribution of ₹55 to ₹200 per month depending on age of entry.

aif.name: Agricultural Infrastructure Fund
aif.desc: Financing for post-harvest management and community farming assets.
aif.details: ₹1 lakh crore fund for post-harvest infrastructure. Interest subvention of 3% for loans up to ₹2 crore for 7 years.

nmsa.name: National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture
nmsa.desc: Promotes sustainable agriculture through climate change adaptation.
nmsa.details: Focuses on rainfed agriculture, soil health management, water use efficiency, and climate resilient farming practices.

pkvy.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
pkvy.desc: Promotes organic farming through cluster-based approach.
pkvy.details: ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years for organic farming including certification, training, and marketing support.
pkvy.eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming

smam.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
smam.desc: Promotes agricultural mechanization among small farmers.
smam.details: Subsidy of 40-50% on purchase of agricultural machinery including tractors, harvesters, and implements.

rkvy.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana
rkvy.desc: Incentivizes states to increase public investment in agriculture.
rkvy.details: Flexible funding for innovative agriculture development projects at state level.

pmksy.name: PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana
pmksy.desc: Support for micro-irrigation and water management.
pmksy.details: Subsidies up to 55-70% for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems. Focus on 'Per Drop More Crop' initiative.

ai.subtitle: हिंदी या अंग्रेज़ी में कोई भी कृषि प्रश्न पूछें
